# Reprummble

> Fitness platform connecting workouts, nutrition, sleep, and wearables. Free to start, live on the web, with iPhone and Android apps coming soon.

Reprummble helps athletes and everyday fitness enthusiasts train smarter, recover faster, and live stronger. It offers an AI workout coach and an offline coach, AI meal logging, daily Recovery, Sleep and Strain scores, and challenges with friends.

## Key Features

- **Workout coach** – an AI coach and an offline rules-based coach build a week of workouts from your goal, body style, equipment, level and injuries; every plan is editable. About 1,000 exercises.
- **Smart nutrition** – meal logging from a photo, with a per-food breakdown, macro targets and lighter swaps.
- **Recovery, Sleep and Strain** – daily scores worked out from your HRV, resting heart rate, sleep and heart rate, measured against your own normal, with the readings that moved each score.
- **Wearables** – Apple Watch (via Apple Health), Samsung Galaxy Watch (via Health Connect), Fitbit, WHOOP and Oura connect directly.
- **Challenges and friends** – 30, 60 and 90-day challenges with friends, a social feed, 24-hour statuses and messages between friends.
- **Apps** – the website is live. The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
